# Getting Help with Grova

Thank you for using **Grova**! We want to make sure you have the best experience possible when using, deploying, or contributing to the project.

---

## 🔍 Frequently Asked Questions & Documentation

Before opening an issue or asking a question, check out our official documentation:

- 🚀 [Deployment & Self-Hosting Guide](../docs/DEPLOYMENT.md) — Step-by-step setup for Vercel, Neon PostgreSQL, Docker, or VPS.
- ⚙️ [CI/CD & Release Pipeline Documentation](../docs/CICD.md) — GitHub Actions workflows, Changesets, and Vercel build optimization.
- 📐 [System Architecture & Technical Design](../docs/ARCHITECTURE.md) — Next.js App Router design, RSC guidelines, and database schema.
- 📜 [Contributing Guide](../CONTRIBUTING.md) — Local development instructions, validation steps, and PR workflow.
- 🛡️ [Community Standards](../docs/COMMUNITY_STANDARDS.md) — Architectural constraints, commit conventions, and review criteria.

---

## ❓ Where Should I Ask My Question?

| Type of Inquiry              | Recommended Location                                                                                         |
| :--------------------------- | :----------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------- |
| **Bug Reports**              | Open a [Bug Report Issue](https://github.com/RanitManik/Grova/issues/new?template=bug_report.yml)            |
| **Feature Requests**         | Open a [Feature Request Issue](https://github.com/RanitManik/Grova/issues/new?template=feature_request.yml)  |
| **Usage & Deployment Q&A**   | Start a [GitHub Discussion](https://github.com/RanitManik/Grova/discussions)                                 |
| **Security Vulnerabilities** | Read our [Security Policy](SECURITY.md) or email [ranitmanik.dev@gmail.com](mailto:ranitmanik.dev@gmail.com) |

---

## 🤝 Code of Conduct

Please remember that all community interactions are governed by our [Code of Conduct](../CODE_OF_CONDUCT.md). Be respectful, inclusive, and helpful.
